Title: Why do hiccups keep hitting you? 3 habits that trigger them

Description:
Hiccups always seem to strike at the worst possible moment - and it's usually not random. A few everyday habits set off the diaphragm spasm behind them more than people realize.

Eating too fast, sudden hot-to-cold temperature swings, and stress or excitement are three of the most common triggers, and each one has a simple fix that still lets you enjoy your meal.

Watch to find out why these habits trigger hiccups, and what to do instead.
